full_judgment: 8. Two other decisions have been cited from the bar. One is the case of Rajashwar Pruned Singh vs. Anaina Prasad Singh A.I.R. 1956 Patna 28 and the other is the case of R.M. Muthukrish-man Chattier and another vs. R. M. Muth-lagiri Chettiar and another A.I.R. 1950 Madras 295 where the words a case open to appeal occurring in Order 43, rule 1 (d) C.P.C. read with section 17 of the Arbitration Act fell fur consideration, but I do not had these two cases to be exactly on the point. Indeed these two cases have proceeded along different lines and have not considered that appeal is a creature of the statute. Order 43, rule 1(d) will apply only in cases of orders arising out of regular suits. If orders passed tinder special statutes are to be made appealable, they must be so made by the special statute itself. The decision of our Appellate Division has dealt with the matter in its correct perspective and the two decisions cited have not touched upon the question of special statute It all.
